notes:
Improved
• Edits are now built in Premiere as small, checkpointed steps instead of one giant command. The old way re-read the whole timeline for every clip, which froze Premiere on long videos.
• Solis paces itself: bigger steps when Premiere is fast, smaller steps and longer pauses when it slows down. Only one step is ever in flight.
• If Premiere or Solis closes mid-edit, your progress is saved. Choose **Resume Edit** to continue where it stopped — nothing already built is rebuilt or duplicated.
• **Pause** and **Cancel** while Premiere is building (they take effect between steps).
• Edits of any length fit (previously over ~600 shots couldn't be sent at all). Sources up to 4 hours.
• Long recordings are transcribed in parts, each saved as it finishes, with a real time estimate.
• Scene detection is about 3× faster; it runs alongside transcription on machines with spare cores.
• Solis' helper processes run at lower priority so Premiere always comes first.
• A dedicated Long Form planner: the video is split into scenes with a purpose (hook, setup, challenge, fail, win, reveal, outro…).
• Full facecam only for real reactions and talking to the viewer, spaced like your reference. Fewer, purposeful zooms.
• Sound effects only for real moments (an image appearing, a reveal, a fail, a win). Never on normal cuts, facecam switches or subtle zooms; no repeated sounds.
• Music per scene with fewer track changes, cut on awkward beats instead of adding a sound.
• Off-camera lines are removed ("don't show that", "hold on", figuring out controls). With a Claude key set, Solis can also trim off-camera logistics.
• Pauses tuned to KAYE's measured long-form cutting. No automatic captions in Long Form.
• New: "cut this pause" and "use the other take" (at the Premiere playhead).
• Learned preferences are now per mode: "fewer zooms" on a Long Form edit no longer changes your Competition Intros.
